title: pr ship treats 'Merge already in progress' as a merge in flight, not exit 70
body:
krn pr ship exits 70 on "GraphQL: Merge already in progress (mergePullRequest)" although the PR merges (PR #1264 merged as 1c6071f; log .krn/runs/lead/ship-1264.log).
Outcome: ship given that gh answer waits for MERGED and exits 0 with its merged verdict line; a regression test with the verbatim message passes.
Proof: the ship test file passes with the verbatim gh message fixture.
